headline.en: Land right on a note, don't slide into it. That's what makes a harmony ring.

detail.en: Hear it in your head first

text.en: Two to warm up. Sing each note back after the guide.
Round 1: listen, then sing each note back on "dah". Start right on it.
Round 2: listen, then sing each note back on "dah". Start right on it.

measures.en: Your stars are for where your notes landed: close to the middle, and without sliding in. It counts your second round.

headline.en: A scoop is sliding up into a note from below. It's a habit, and habits change.

detail.en: Starts low, slides up to the note
Think the note before you breathe in

text.en: First slide up into each note on purpose. Then sing it again, starting right on it.
Four notes, each one clean. Listen, think it, then land on it.

measures.en: Your stars are for clean starts, close to the middle. A note that slid in counts half.

headline.en: Do is your note. Re, mi, fa and so are the steps up from it: 2, 3, 4 and 5.

detail.en: A jump of three and of five up

text.en: Hear the pair, then two quiet beats: hear it in your head. Then sing it. Did you hear it before you sang?
Do to so, so to do, do to mi, la (below) to do. Each note short and separate.

measures.en: Your stars are for landing each note of the leaps cleanly, close to the middle.

headline.en: The Westminster chimes: four little tunes on four notes, each note its own clean start.

detail.en: Each note separate, like a bell
Think it, breathe, start on it

text.en: Your Bullseye round first: five notes, to see how far you've come.
The first chime. Listen, then sing it back.
All four chimes. After each one, it's your turn.

measures.en: Your stars are for landing all sixteen notes cleanly, close to the middle. A note that slid in counts half.
